featured.title: Hebrew calendar throughout the app
featured.description: Choose a Hebrew or Gregorian primary calendar. Display, periods, standing orders, and reminders follow that calendar. The default stays Gregorian.

help.title: Secondary date display
help.description: You can show the other calendar as display-only text. It does not change filters or calculations.

halacha.title: Hebrew standing orders and reminders
halacha.description: Set a Hebrew day of the month. Reminders skip Friday, Saturday, and Israel Yom Tov.

reminders.title: Maaser year summary
reminders.description: Analytics includes a report from 1 Tishrei through 29 Elul. The home-page tithe balance is not reset.
